'''[[Kollam district]]''', earlier called Quilon district, is one of the 14 districts of [[Kerala]] [[States and territories of India|state]], [[India]]. The district is representative of all the natural attributes of Kerala states, and is endowed with a long coastal region, a major sea port on the [[Arabian Sea]], plains and the mountains, lakes, [[lagoon]]s and [[Kerala Backwaters]], forests and the farm land, and rivers and streams. The area had mercantile relationship with [[Phoenicia]]ns and the [[Ancient Rome|Romans]].
